name: @livecore/ui-core
description: Generic, product-neutral UI primitive contracts for LiveCore vertical apps: the variant vocabularies (tone, size, emphasis, surface level, layout), the typed prop shape of each generic primitive and the pure variant-resolution defaults. Framework-agnostic and types-first; verticals render the actual components.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test tests/ui-core.build.test.mjs tests/ui-core.pack.test.mjs
